This is a one-off observation trial, not a policy interface. It uses recorded
joint positions only; the gripper channel is left at its current position.
Each target is interpolated to at most 1 degree per axis, then checked against

One authorized PiPER V2 gripper opening to the recorded 7.1 mm start.

The 0x159 command necessarily contains a gripper-enable bit. It does not
enable arm joints, home, alter mode, or replay a trajectory. A human must
remain beside the physical E-stop. USB close is not an emergency stop.

One-shot supervised, joint-only return to a recorded episode start.

Not a general trajectory player or policy interface. Each waypoint differs
by at most 1.0 degree per joint. No enable, mode, home, gripper, or software
stop command is sent. The operator must watch and own the physical E-stop.

Smooth supervised joint-only replay of the saved PiPER episode.

The recorded episode is sampled into a continuous cubic Hermite position
profile, time-scaled to conservative velocity/acceleration limits, and sent at
fixed frequency. It first reverses the same path to the episode start, then
plays forward. The gripper and policy model are not connected.
